## Requirements
1. Diagnose and pin which contract leg moves — (a) the deterministic re-drive re-mints the dispatch-ceremony events so the shared allocator stays in step, vs (b) the recorded-terminal ports match calls positionally/by-content. Owned decision → new ADR naming the rejected alternative; divergence reporting stays honest (a real divergence still answers `invalid{replay_diverged}`).
2. Implement the chosen leg in `hh-control`/`hh-embed` (`hh-ledger` only if the ceremony re-mint lives there): deterministic replay of a run carrying `action.effect.*`/`security.permission.decided`/`verification.*` ceremony rows re-drives byte-identically.
3. Regression test that fails if removed: a recorded fixture run carrying the 13-row dispatch ceremony asserts `replay{deterministic}` = byte-identical; a mutation asserts a real divergence still fails loudly.
4. Spec conform: amend-by-protocol only if the spec pins the changed mechanism; else the ADR records silence.
5. Live re-verification: re-run the diverged arm via `scripts/live-verify.sh` — prefer the USD-0 re-drive of the committed record → `live-executed` `hh-live-evidence/1` + SPEND.jsonl debit; honestly `skipped(<reason>)` if `provided: no` (STOP-and-ask); declared bound USD 5.
6. The mechanism ADR + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md`/`REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md`.
7. Records: L4.6's `blockedOn` discharged via dated append-only notes on `runs/L4.6.md` + the capstone report's finding block.
- Size budget: 600 changed non-mechanical lines (fix + tests + ADR + records; evidence records and regenerated artifacts excluded). Clear overrun → STOP committed + surface before push/PR.

## Plan
- Mechanism choice: (a) — the re-drive re-mints the recorded gate-emitted ceremony rows through the same append path the live drive used. `extract_recorded` reclassifies the recorded gate `emitted` rows (driver-intended window rows naming the effect, minus `decider:human` permission rows) as re-emitted rows (`driver_seqs` lattice + per-effect emitted list, out of `external_events`); `ReplayGate::dispatch` re-serves them in `GateOutcome.emitted` so `append_producer` mints the same `e-N` ids — the shared `next_id` allocator stays in step. `EffectGate::producer_component` widened `&'static str` → `&str` so the re-minted rows carry the *recorded* producer ref (INV-7 honesty). (b) rejected — positional/by-content matching would need allocator-id normalization inside compared payloads, weakening byte-identity and masking id-sequence tampering. Spec §05a R-2.2.4 pins the contract (reproduce decision/assembled sequences; dispatch no effect; honest divergence), not the mechanism → ADR records silence, no spec text moves.
- Fix: `crates/hh-control/src/replay.rs` (extract + ReplayGate + RecordedInputs), `crates/hh-control/src/driver.rs` (trait sig), `crates/hh-embed/src/runtime.rs` (EmbedGate impl sig). No `hh-ledger` change — the re-mint lives in hh-control.
- Tests: `crates/hh-control/tests/l4_6b.rs` — a ceremony-emitting gate fixture (dispatch → ceremony → more model calls) recorded through the real Driver loop, replayed → `reproduced()`; id-parity + mutation-diverges asserts. `crates/hh-embed/tests/l4_6b.rs` — the real boundary end-to-end: host-capability dispatch (pending → `report_host_effect`) + `hh_submit` completion through `EmbedService`, then `replay{deterministic}` mode == deterministic.
- Live leg: new `live-verify.sh` leg `l4-6b-replay` (USD 0, no names — scripted lane through the real boundary) driving a gated cell `l46b_replay_effect_run` → `hh-live-evidence/1` + SPEND 0.
- ADR-0381 + adr-index/REVISIT regeneration; dated notes on runs/L4.6.md + the capstone report finding block; closeout per §6.5.
